origin.description: Writes a data frame to a Stata .dta file.
origin.usage: write_dta(data, path, version = 14, label = attr(data, "label"), strl_threshold = 2045, adjust_tz = TRUE)

arguments.name: strl_threshold
arguments.text: Strings longer than this are stored as strL when the version is at least 13.

arguments.name: adjust_tz
arguments.text: When true, a zoned datetime is written as the same clock time in UTC.

origin.details: Factors become integer labelled columns. A tagged missing value is kept. Names must be valid Stata names, and Stata 13 and earlier reject unicode names that are not simple identifiers.
origin.example:
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".dta")
x <- labelled(c(1, tagged_na("a")), c(ok = 1), label = "lab")
write_dta(tibble::tibble(x = x), tmp, label = "hello")
d <- read_dta(tmp)
cat(attr(d, "label"), d$x[1], na_tag(d$x)[2], "\n")
unlink(tmp)

translation.description: Writes a data frame to a Stata .dta file.
translation.usage: write_dta(data, path, version=14, label=None, strl_threshold=2045, adjust_tz=True)

arguments.name: strl_threshold
arguments.text: Strings longer than this are stored as strL when the version is at least 13.

arguments.name: adjust_tz
arguments.text: When true, a zoned datetime is written as the same clock time in UTC.

translation.details: Factors become integer labelled columns. A tagged missing value is kept. Names must be valid Stata names, and Stata 13 and earlier reject unicode names that are not simple identifiers.
translation.example:
import os, tempfile
from haven import labelled, read_dta, tagged_na, write_dta, na_tag
from tibble import new_tibble
path = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".dta")
tag = tagged_na("a")[0]
x = labelled([1.0, tag], {"ok": 1.0}, label="lab")
write_dta(new_tibble([x], nrow=2, names=["x"]), path, label="hello")
d = read_dta(path)
print(d.label, d.columns[0].values[0], na_tag(d.columns[0])[1])
os.remove(path)
